GoLaravel

A Laravel-inspired Go framework that brings elegant design patterns and developer experience to the Go ecosystem.

Get Started Documentation

Features

Service Container

Powerful dependency injection with automatic resolution, bindings, and singletons.

Expressive Routing

Define routes with groups, parameters, middleware, and named routes.

Built-in Middleware

CORS, Auth, Rate Limiting, Secure Headers, and more out of the box.

Request & Response

Fluent API for handling HTTP requests and building responses.

Validation

Laravel-style validation rules: required, email, min, max, and more.

Database ORM

Query builder with fluent interface and model-based ORM.

Getting Started

Installation

go get github.com/yourusername/golaravel

Quick Example

package main

import (
    "golaravel/app"
    "golaravel/app/http/request"
    "golaravel/app/http/response"
    "golaravel/app/http/middleware"
)

func main() {
    application := app.New()

    // Register middleware
    application.Router.Use(middleware.Logger())
    application.Router.Use(middleware.Recovery())

    // Define routes
    application.Router.Get("/", func(req *request.Request, res *response.Response) error {
        return res.JSON(map[string]string{
            "message": "Welcome to GoLaravel!",
        })
    })

    application.Router.Get("/users/{id}", func(req *request.Request, res *response.Response) error {
        id := req.Param("id")
        return res.JSON(map[string]string{
            "user_id": id,
        })
    })

    // Start server
    application.Run(":5000")
}
